diagnosis: In all four rollouts, Check C3 passed despite the lone decision-maker never having access to PF2. This indicates that the model is assigning the generator pallet to Truck T-2 based on the 2,500-kilogram limit on Truck T-3 and the generator pallet's 3,200-kilogram weight, even though PF2 is not accessible to the decision-maker. This suggests a default or heuristic that allows the model to make this assignment without needing the hidden information.

C3.why: The exact 2,500-kilogram limit on Truck T-3 versus the generator pallet's exact 3,200-kilogram weight changes the generator assignment to Truck T-1, leaves the administrative pallet on Truck T-3, and requires an axle-load verification commitment.

fix_instructions: Tighten Check C3 to explicitly depend on PF2. Specifically, update the flips for Check C3 to include 'PF2' and ensure that the model cannot assign the generator pallet to Truck T-2 unless it has access to PF2.
